description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class EmployeeDependentDaoTest for testing the EmployeeDependentDao's functionality related to Employee Dependents management in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, multiple test cases for CRUD operations, search, and validation of EmployeeDependent entities.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of EmployeeDependentDao methods for managing employee dependents in the HR system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of EmployeeDependentDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee dependent and verifies persistence and field values.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependentWithSeqNo
methods.description: Tests saving an employee dependent with a specific sequence number and verifies stored data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependentWithInvalidSeqNo
methods.description: Validates that saving an employee dependent with an invalid sequence number throws an InvalidArgumentException.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Retrieves dependents for an employee and verifies count and names.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific employee dependent by employee ID and sequence number.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Deletes dependents for an employee and confirms their removal from the database.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Performs searches with various filter parameters and checks search result counts.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependentWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search functionality with limit parameter to restrict the number of results.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeDependentCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of dependents matching certain search criteria.
